savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_14148: sec. 2 revokes 78 listed actions, no effective-date wording, so effective on signing 2025-01-20; sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation and tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders; sec. 4(a) is a no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions only; there is no successor delegation, transfer of functions or funds, pending-matter clause or exception for any listed order. Own-residual check, reading EO 14087 in full (secs. 1-3): it revokes or amends no order, transfers no function, fund or property and creates no office or right (sec. 3(c)). Sec. 2 asks the Secretary of HHS to consider Innovation Center payment and delivery models and to report; any model tested rests on 42 U.S.C. 1315a(b)(2), not on a right created by the order, and the report duty is a one-time deadline. EO 14148 sec. 2(zz) revokes EO 14087; its sec. 3(b) review of actions taken under it is not a savings clause. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) KEPT after reading both. Bounded search: every held official FR text (jobs/fr-originals, EO 1 through EO 14435) was grepped for the order's number and read where it appeared; OFR catalog edges (jobs/later-events EDGES.csv), the dossier's current-law leads (none) and the three machine searches were read.

research_rationale: EO 14087 (signed 2022-10-14, 87 FR 63399-63400), read in full from the held official FR text, states the drug-cost policy (sec. 1), asks HHS to consider Innovation Center models, report in 90 days and test the models (sec. 2) and has general provisions (sec. 3). It has no term or sunset. EO 14148 sec. 2(zz) (reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes it with no effective-date wording, effective on signing 2025-01-20. Dossier missing lines read: the large actor context EO 14036 (held official text, sha256 346da9d6..., and the overflow file jobs/claim-kit/output/actor-texts/EO_14036.json) was searched in full for EO 14087 and does not name it; EO 14036 predates EO 14087 by 15 months and the OFR 'See: EO 14087' note on EO 14036 is EO 14087's own reference to it, so it is ruled out as a later event. The 90-day report deadline in sec. 2 is a deadline, never an end; the sec. 2 duty to test selected models has no stated completion, and no source shows the duty performed and finished before 2025-01-20, so the first end is the revocation. The inventory is the dossier's seven contiguous clauses and is kept. No other held official text names EO 14087. Savings: none found.
